{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only
total_revenue = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']['revenue'].sum()

# Check how many test orders were removed
num_test_orders = len(df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99])

# Print the final result and verification
print(f"Number of internal test orders removed: {num_test_orders}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Return the value for submission
total_revenue"}
